sections.content: Ez means 'this' and az means 'that'. Before a noun, they are followed by the definite article a (or az before a vowel), giving ez a / az a. The demonstrative and the article are two separate words, even though they sit side by side.
Don't merge az (that) with the article a/az (the) into one word. 'Az a bolt' is literally 'that the shop' -- az points, a is just the article that always precedes bolt.
